headline: Small clean S swell with light wind — a fun morning log.
today: Just over a foot at short period, but the NNW offshore this morning and the light W wind through the afternoon keep it glassy and rideable. Best around the morning high through the midday low — bring the log and enjoy a mellow one. Not much size, but the conditions are the nicest of the day anywhere in range.

daysToWatch.note: Prime SE angle shows up but it's tiny at under a foot and the wind goes cross-on to onshore. Worth a peek if the long-period lines organize, otherwise log it soft.
Swell jumps into the 3-4ft range with NW offshore in the morning. The standout day — get there early before the afternoon cross-off texture. Shortboard weather.
Long-period S energy up to 11s and 2-plus feet, NE cross-off in the morning. Could be a fun clean one before the evening onshore.
